text: Pető Kristóf sörfőzőnk ötlete. Az alap Imperial Stout, aminek jellegzetes csokis ízjegyei mellé igazából bármilyen csoki-ihletésű dolog illik, most kapott egy jó nagy adag mogyorótöretet és karamellt. A sör maga Bourbon hordókban érlelődött, hogy az alap ízjegyek kapjanak egy kis whiskey-s, hordós tuningot. The base is an Imperial Stout, whose distinctive chocolate notes pair well with any chocolate-inspired addition, and now it’s been given a generous amount of crushed hazelnuts and caramel. The beer itself was aged in Bourbon barrels to give the base flavors a touch of whiskey and barrel-aged finesse.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2020 Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Bourbon Barrels With Chocolate & Coffee
text: This beer is a 12% ABV Russian Imperial Stout, that was brewed with 12 types of malts, 6 hours of boil time, and 3 months of fermenting to prepare it for a long journey in two types of freshly emptied Bourbon barrels. The finished beer was soaked on freshly roasted Ethiopean Coffee beans and cocoa beans from Ghana. The result is a beer rich in notes of coffee, chocolate, vanilla and bourbon which we gladly recommend for every beer lover.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2022 Double Baltic Porter Aged In Rhum Barrels
text: In 2021, Horizont brewed its first Double Baltic Porter and from the first time we sampled it, we knew it had huge potential and needed to explored more thoroughly as a style. For this 2022 vintage, we chose Rhum Agricole barrels from Saint-Martin Island in the Caribbean so the recipe had to be changed to fit the essence of the barrel. The base beer is a pleasantly chocolatey, nutty, full-bodied, and sweet dark brown/black lager. Yes, it's a lager, as bottom-fermented yeast is traditionally used for this style, and due to the neutral fermentation, this type allows the malty, hoppy, and barrel notes to prevail. Enjoy this spectacular beer!Amikor 2021-ben lefőztük és kóstoltuk az első Double Baltic Porterünket, tudtuk, hogy ebben a stílusban hatalmas potenciál van. A 2022-es vintage tételt már más típusú, Rhum Agricole érlelésére felhasznált hordókba tettük. Ehhez egy kicsit módosítanunk kellett a maláta profilon a 2021-es verzióhoz képest. Az alap egy kellemesen csokis, mogyorós, testes és édeskés sötétbarna/fekete lager. Igen, lager, mivel hagyományosan alsóerjesztésű élesztőt használnak ehhez a stílushoz, illetve az ízsemleges erjedés miatt ez a típus hagyja jobban érvényesülni a malátás, komlós és hordós jegyeket.

text: Fahéjjal és vaníliával fűszerezett Pastry Stout, amelynek alapötlete a kuglóf volt. Az alapsör HBC 472 komlóval készült, amely segített elmélyíteni a hordós érlelés során átvett Tennessee whiskey hordók fás, hihetetlenül vaníliás ízjegyeit. A tökéletes ízvilágát a hozzáadott fahéjjal érte el ez a testes, zamatos sörkülönlegesség. This bottle hides an Imperial Pastry Stout made with cinnamon and vanilla, based on the idea of true love and a bundt cake.The base beer is made with American experimental hops called HBC 472, which helps to deepen the woody, vanilla flavors of the Tennessee whiskey barrels used during barrel maturation. In order to achieve the perfect taste, we added cinnamon to the beer's mouthfeel to achieve this gourmet beer specialty.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2022 Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Bourbon Barrels with Chocolate & Coffee
text: In 2020, when we tasted the first version of this beer, we felt a sense of pride like never before. This feeling has persisted every year since then. Our base beer is a midnight black, full-bodied Russian imperial stout, which we then matured on freshly roasted Ethiopian variant of a Budapest specialty coffee roaster and Ghanaian cocoa beans. All this was poured into freshly emptied bourbon barrels and aged for nearly a year to reach its most beautiful form. Enjoy this splendid beer!2020-ban amikor megkóstoltuk ennek a sörnek az első verzióját, akkor olyan büszkeség fogott el bennünket, mint előtte még soha. Ezt az érzést azóta is minden évben érezzük. Az alapsörünk egy éjfekete, testes russian imperial stout, amit egy budapesti specialty kávépörkölő frissen pörkölt etiópiai variánsán és ghánai kakaóbabon érleltünk utána. Mindezt frissen ürített bourbon hordókba fejtettük és érleltük közel egy évig, hogy elérje a legszebb formáját.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2022 Wheat Wine Aged In Bourbon & Rum Barrels
text: For years we have considered blending our Wheat Wine Whiskey barrel aged beer with the Wheat Wine Rhum version. 2022 is the year it comes to fruition by blending these two great beers with a mixed barrel Wheat Wine. Our brewmaster, along with the team worked diligently to blend the proper proportions of each to create this unique brew. The whiskey barrel comes from a small American distillery while the Rhum Agricole barrel came from Saint Martin Island in the Caribbean. The third barrel started its journey in Tennessee filled with whiskey then traveled to Jamaica to be filled with Rum before making its way to Hungary to be filled with a portion of the beer you have in your hand. Enjoy this astonishing beer! Régóta szerettük volna blendelni a rumos és a bourbon hordókban érlelt búzaborunkat. 2022-ben valóra is váltottuk, méghozzá egy érdekes, tripla blend formájában. Kitartóan dolgoztunk az arányok eltalálásán, hogy létrehozzuk ezt az egyedi tételt. Az egyik, whiskey-s hordóban, amit ehhez a sörhöz választottunk, egy kis amerikai lepárló bourbon-je volt előzőleg. A rumoshordók a karibi-térségi Szent Martin szigetről származnak, ahol előzőleg Rhum Agricole voltak bennük. A harmadik hordóban először Tennessee Whiskey volt, majd áthajózott Jamaicába és ott egy zseniális rumot töltöttek bele, ezután mikor kiürült, nálunk landolt, hogy megtölthessük azzal a sörrel, amit a kezedben tartasz.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2022 Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Tennessee Whiskey Barrels
text: The Original Night Shift beer has returned to its founding! In 2016 when this beer was first brewed, it started the journey of the Night Shift line of beers. The 2022 version returns to the beginning, when it was matured only, and exclusively, in Tennessee Whiskey barrels. No spices, just the barrel, malt and hops. Every year we polish the recipe to make it more perfect and even silkier. Enjoy this classic beer!Ezzel a tétellel visszatértünk az eredeti Night Shift gyökereihez. Amikor 2016-ban lefőztük ennek a sörnek az első verzióját, nem is sejtettük, hogy hová vezet az útja. 2018-ban elkészült az első hordóérlelt változata, megkezdve a hosszú utazást, aminek most egy állomásához érkeztünk. Azóta is töretlen népszerűségnek örvend, és minden évben csiszolunk rajta egy kicsit, hogy még tökéletesebb és még selymesebb legyen. A 2022-es verzió visszatér a kezdetekhez, amikor csak és kizárólag Tennessee Whiskey hordóban érleltük. Semmi fűszer, csak a hordó, maláta és a komló, egy igazi klasszikus.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2023 - Rye Wine Aged In Bourbon Barrels - Aged 2 Years
text: Ez a zamatos és egyedi ízélményt nyújtó, karamellizált rozsmalátával, valamint rozspehellyel készült rozsbor egy hihetetlenül krémes, gyümölcsös ízvilágú sör. Az alap rozsbort két évig érleltük Bourbon hordókban, az ez idő alatt átvett fás-viszkis ízjegyek komplex és kivételes ízvilágot adtak ennek az egészen különleges sörnek. With this Rye wine, we ventured further into the realm of the grain wine. From the point of view of brewing, we made the base beer with rye, an undeservedly underrated brewing grain, which was aged in bourbon barrels for nearly two years. Of course, we didn't just use plain, basic rye malt, since with this excellent beer we aim to show the diversity of this grain, so we also used two types of caramelized rye malt and rye flakes to create this unique beer.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2022 Imperial Pecan Pie Stout Aged In Tennessee Whiskey Barrels
text: A Horizont Night Shift tételei között minden évben megtalálható egy pastry stout. A 2022-es év „sütis” Night Shiftjéhez egy klasszikus amerikai süteményt, a pekándiós pitét vettük alapul. A pekándiós pite története az 1880-as évekig tekint vissza, és kimondottan kedvelt az USA deli államaiban, ahol a bourbon whiskey-t készítik, így természetesnek vettük, hogy hordóérleléshez egy Tennessee whiskey-s hordót válasszunk. Mivel a lepárló, ahonnan érkezett, karakteresebb, számottevően vaníliásabb esszenciájú hordókat használ, így ez fantasztikusan áll az alapsörnek, illetve a teljes koncepciónak is. Az alapsör egy sűrű, testes imperial stout, amibe rengeteg házilag pörkölt pekándiót tettünk, így kinyerve belőle az ízeket.ENEach year in the Horizont Night Shift line, we present to you a new pastry stout. The 2022 version is an expression of an American classic dessert, the pecan pie. The Pecan pie dates back to the 1880’s and is very popular in the Southern States where bourbon whiskey is made, so it was a natural fit to age this beer in Tennessee whiskey barrels. The distillery from which the barrels came emphasizes considerably more vanilla essence which is perfect for this brew. The base beer is an Imperial Stout which is a thick, full-bodied beer which was put into the barrels then we added copious amounts of home-roasted pecans, thus extracting the flavors from it. Enjoy this special beer!

Az alapsör pörkölt malátás jegyei és a Bourbon hordók klasszikus, utánozhatatlan ízvilága már alapból egy egészen különleges, minden évben egyre harmonikusabb ízvilágot alkotnak az egy éves érlelés során, de az igazi varázslat a kakaó- és kávébab megszokott ízjegyeinek átvételekor történik. This beer surprises us each year, since the harmony between the base beer and the barrels turns out to be something magical. Add the classical taste of cocoa and coffee beans, and the perfect barrel aged beer is suddenly in front of you.

It was the first barrel-aged pastry imperial stout for us as well as the first collab within the series and, you've been our witness, we learned so much from these guys. The second release Somlói Nodler already set the bar higher, but we are pretty sure that this third coming of the Somlói is 'the crème de la crème', a real blast of flavours and memories. text: Quadruple dry hopped Quadruple IPA in collaboration with HopcaveDry hopped with Citra, Mosaic & Nelson.We decided to brew our first ever QIPA to celebrate our good friend Felipe (Hopcave) reaching his 10,000th new beer (his 600th from FW) on Untappd. name: All You Need is Oak
text: Whisky BA Imperial Stout, 36° Plato, 14% ABV. Tohle je nejmohutnější pivo, co jsme doposud uvařili. Třicetšestka, které trávila 17 měsíců v několika čerstvých barelech po lokální whisky, dokud jsme nebyli přesvědčeni, že chutná přesně podle našich představ. Z téhle krémově husté, černočerné kapaliny přímo leze podmanivé aroma karamelu, mléčné čokolády a vanilky. Zbytkový cukr precizně vyvažuje vyšší obsah alkoholu s jemnou taninovou strukturou z dlouhého zrání ve dřevě. Cíleně jsme se vyhnuli jakýmkoliv obvyklým ochucovadlům, abychom ukázali, jak může chutnat čistý stout, když dostane dostatek času v těch správných podmínkách.This is the biggest beer we’ve brewed thus far. The 36-plato thick stout spent almost 17 months in several super-fresh locally sourced whisky barrels until we felt they are just where we want them to be. Luscious, thick, blackest black kind of liquid presents the overpowering aroma of dark caramel, milk chocolate and vanilla. Residual sugars are tightly balanced with high alcohol content and light tannic structure from the long wood ageing. Strictly avoiding any adjuncts, we wanted this beer to be a pure expression of what a big stout can be when you give it enough time in the right conditions.

name: Coconut Vanilla Cacao Stout 2021
text: Pro naše kakaovo-vanilkové barelové pivo jsme vytvořili blend z 18 měsíců stařených stoutů z bourbonových sudů s jemnějším charakterem, které slouží jako základ pro přídavek kakaa, kakaových bobů a vanilky. Vzniká tak velmi hřejivý zážitek s komplexní chutí, která se skvěle pojí s dřevitým charakterem sudů.For our cocoa-vanilla barrel-aged beer we blended several of our 18 months bourbon barrel aged stouts that developed a softer character, providing a great base for addition of cacao, cocoa nibs and vanilla beans. So came to be a warming sensation with complex flavour, that well compliments the woody properties given by the barrels.

name: Peanut Cacao Stout 2021
text: This year’s experiment is the first time we ever used peanut flour in beer. For this creation we choose some of the smoother stouts from this year’s 18 months aged bourbon barrels, so that the peanut flavour really comes forward. As a companion to peanuts we reached after cocoa nibs, that adds to the complexity of the base stout. Illustrations for our barrels series are made by indie artists, so that the quality of the packaging reflects the quality of the beers. Label artist is David Mazanec.

name: Coconut Stout 2023
text: Coconut Stout se vrací každý rok a každý rok ztělesňuje naší posedlost extrakcí kvalitního kokosu. Pro tento blend dvouletých stoutů vybíráme ty hořčí a drsnější barely, ty jsou pak po přidání obrovské množství praženého kokosu zjemněny a výsledek je tak vyvážený. Etiketu pro Coconut Stout už dělá po třetí Mára Čmára.Coconut Stout returns year after year, embodying our obsession with extracting quality coconut. For this blend of two-year-old stouts, we choose the bitterest and harshest barrels, which are then softened after adding a huge amount of roasted coconut, and the result is thus very balanced. This is the third time Mára Čmára is making the label for Coconut Stout.

name: Here And Now: Apricot
text: Coolshipped and spontaneously fermented beer in an oak barrel for 16 months and aged further on organic local apricots for 12 months. Again, different and unique barrel with distinct and standalone character. In this one I am trying to capture the unique essence of one day into a beer and imprint of local terroir and layering the hand picked apricots from a local orchard. Multiple old varieties of apricots give a really complex expression of the fruit and prolonged aging make for a deep, rich flavour. The backbone of a beer is again built on local organic barley malt and raw organic spelt from the local Hare Krishna community, where they live and function in a low intervention and organic way for the last 3 decades.

name: Coconut Tiramisu Barley + Wheat Wine 2024
text: Tento blend dvou sudů ječného a dvou sudů pšeničného vína jsme po 30 měsících ve dřevě nablendovali do jednoho tanku a ochutili kokosem, a amarettem tak abychom přiblížili chuť italského dezertu Tiramisu. Fotografii na etiketu nám poskytl jirkovský fotograf Jakub Soukup.This blend of two barrels of barley wine and two barrels of wheat wine was blended into one tank after 30 months in wood and flavored with coconut and amaretto to bring it close to the flavour of the Italian dessert Tiramisu. The photography for the label was provided by Jakub Soukup, a photographer from our town of Jirkov.

name: Coffee Maple Syrup Stout 2021
text: Po osmnácti měsících ležení jsme vybrali bourbon barely pro blend, do kterého přijde javorový sirup a káva z naší spřátelené pražírny Doubleshot. Výsledný stout je jemný, sladší, s lehkým kávovým aroma. Jasná krbová záležitost, která vás zahřeje ve studených měsících.After 18 months of maturing, we chose specific barrels for a blend that will well encapsulate the addition of maple syrup and coffe from our favorit Prague-based roastery Doubleshot. The resulting stout is sweeter with a mild coffe character. A great fireplace drink to accompany you through the cold winter months.

name: Winter Affair Gossip: Vogelsang
text: Otevíráme novou sérii spoluprací Winter Affair Gossip 2026, kterou jsme odstartovali collabem s rakouským pivovarem Vogelsang – jedním z hostů letošního zichoveckého festivalu Winter Affair. A jak chutná naše první společné pivo? Jako ovocný zážitek v podobě ice cream souru – ale tentokrát úplně bez živočišných složek. Místo klasické laktózy jsme použili veganský zmrzlinový prášek, který dodává pivu krémovost a sladkost, a přitom zůstává plně vhodný i pro ty, kdo se laktóze vyhýbají. Základ tvoří kombinace malin, ostružin a černého rybízu, kterou doplňuje jemně zemitý tón červené řepy. Celý chuťový profil pak uzavírá sladká a aromatická tonka, která dodává kulatost a jemně kořeněný závěr. Výsledkem je pivo, které chutná jako dezert – sladké, kyselé, voňavé, s krásnou barvou a hladkou texturou. Není to pastry sour, ale má podobný efekt: potěší smysly a osladí život. A vegani si ho konečně můžou vychutnat naplno.

name: Dark Ritual
text: Hazelnut, Vanilla & Cocoa Imperial Stout, 30° Plato, 11.6% ABV. Vaření Imperial Stoutu je vždycky svým způsobem rituál – začíná se velmi brzy ráno s nekonečným množstvím sladu, pokračuje se bolestivě pomalým procesem scezování a pak dlouhým varem končícím pozdě v noci. Po pečlivém kvašení ho necháváme měsíce ležet v tanku, a když máme pocit, že je dostatečně hladký, přidáme třešničku na dortu. Tou jsou lískové ořechy podpořené špetkou vanilky a kakaa. Stvořili jsme robustní 11% smetanově černý Stout, která chutná jako jemné pralinky z té nejtmavší čokolády. Hořký závěr, žádná laktóza, žádná ulepená sladkost - jen mnoho různých sladů a okultní umění vaření v dokonalé harmonii.Brewing Imperial Stout is always a kind of ritual here - starting early in the morning with mountains of grain, stretching through painfully slow lautering process and endless boil ending late at night. After careful fermentation we lager it for months and when we feel it’s smooth enough, we add the finishing touch. We thought this one might work nicely with some hazelnuts supported with a dose of vanilla and cocoa. What we got is a robust 11% pitch-black brew tasting like fine pralines from the darkest possible chocolate. Bitter finish, no lactose, no cloying sweetness, just 10+ different malts and the occult art of brewing in perfect harmony.

name: Zima 2023
text: Cognac BA English Barleywine, 36° Plato, 13.8% ABV. Pamatujete si naši loňskou Zimu? Uvedli jsme ji jen v limitovaném množství se špetkou ancho chilli, ale většinu várky jsme ukryli do čerstvých sudů po koňaku, ať tam dozraje. Po dlouhém odpočinku se vrací větší, silnější a intenzivnější. Sušené švestky a karamel původního anglického barleywine teď doplnily v aroma sušené rozinky, fíkový džem, dřevitá vanilka a jemné taniny. Ty ideálně vyvažují vyšší zbytkový cukr a hutnější tělo, které dodávají impozantní plnost a přechází do příjemně hřejivého závěru. Ideální pivo ke krbu.

name: Yummy Pink Guava, Peach, Passion Fruit & Vanilla
text: Pastry Sour Ale w/ Fruit, 22° Plato, 5.4% ABV. Tohle pivo je naším pokusem přivábit zpátky teplé počasí: zima už nám leze krkem, proto jsme si uvařili zatím nejexotičtější Yummy. Náš multivitamínový džus s trochou hřejivého alkoholu (než se to slunce vrátí) je spojením marakuji s růžovou guavou a trochou broskví, což ještě podtrhuje mexická vanilka. Finální výsledek je přímo definicí léta ve sklenici, která by se neztratila ani na stole se snídaní. Ne že bychom něco naznačovali, jenom informujeme.This Yummy is us trying to lure the warm weather back: sick already of the winter, we brewed our most exotic Yummy so far. The multi-vitamin juice with some warming alcohol content (for before the sun returns) combines passion fruit and pink guava with some peach, all highlighted by our favourite Mexican vanilla. The final blend is the very definition of summer in a glass and would not look inappropriate on a breakfast table. We’re not giving any hints here, just stating.

name: Yummy Pineapple, Papaya & Coconut
text: Pastry Sour Ale, 24° Plato, 5.1% ABV. Letní koktejl do studené zimy! Tentokrát jsme náš pivní tank naplnili hromadami ananasu a papáji a přidali trochu kokosu a vanilky. V kombinaci se sladkým tělem má tato mňamka inspirovaná piña coladou tak daleko od piva s chutí piva, jak jen to jde. Tohle je v podstatě léto v plechovce, takže vás naladí a nadchne na letní dovolenou dlouho před příchodem skutečného léta.Temperatures outside recently rose above freezing point, so it’s obviously the right time for a summer cocktail. Long overdue, here is the new Yummy! This time we filled the tank with heaps of pineapple and papaya and added some coconut and vanilla. Combined with its chewy body, this piña colada-inspired Yummy is about as far from a beer-flavoured beer as it gets. Basically an instant summer in a can to provide a beach fix before the actual summer arrives.

name: Zima 2025
text: Bourbon Barrel Aged Barley Wine w/ Tonka & Cacao, 32° Plato, 11% ABV. Po trpělivém zrání v sudech po bourbonu letošní Zima odhaluje štědrou paletu chutí: sušené ovoce jako švestky a rozinky, jemné vanilkové tóny a bohaté vrstvy karamelizovaného sladu. Charakter sudu dodává pivu hloubku a vyzrálost, k vyváženosti a svátečnímu pocitu přispívá následné doležení s kakaovými a tonka boby. Vytříbené barley wine stvořené pro výjimečné chvíle — nebo pro to, aby proměnilo obyčejný večer v tichou oslavu.After resting patiently in bourbon barrels, this year’s Zima reveals a rich tapestry of flavours: dried fruits like plum and raisin, soft vanilla warmth, and gentle layers of caramelised malt. The barrel character lends depth and maturity, yet the beer remains smooth and surprisingly graceful. A refined barley wine crafted for meaningful moments — or for turning an ordinary evening into something quietly celebratory.

name: Stout Laphroaig – Barrel project
text: 18 months laphroaig barrel aged

name: Stout Laphroaig 2021
text: Legendární whisky skotské palírny Laphroaig si získala přízeň mnoha. Její nekompromisní chuť založená na nakuřování sladu rašelinovým kouřem cení i mnozí v našem pivovaru. Proto se stala při výběru sudu pro náš barelový projekt jasnou volbou. Náš stout se po 18 měsících staření může pyšnit opravdu silnou rašelinovou chutí.Legendary Scottish whisky distilery Laphroiag has earned respect of masses. It's uncompromising flavour based on peated malt is loved by many of our brewery colleagues and so it's always an easy choice when we are deciding what barrels to fill fo our aging project. After 18 months the peat really comes forward, rewarding ours and our customer's patience.

name: Yummy Blueberry, Raspberry, Chocolate & Maple Syrup
text: Pastry Sour Ale w/ Fruit, 20° Plato, 5.4% ABV. Ano, legislativně je to pořád pivo! Naše nové Yummy opět posouvá hranice o něco dál: tohle hustě sametové a agresivně fialové smoothie vzniklo spojením absurdního množství borůvkového a malinového pyré s nejtmavším javorovým sirupem, jaký jsme našli, a navrch trochou čokolády. Na svůj obsah alkoholu se pije až nebezpečně lehce. Vyzkoušeno!It doesn’t look like it, but legally it is still a beer! Our new Yummy is pushing the boundaries again a bit further: this creamy, thick, offensively purple beer-smoothie combines absurd amounts of blueberry and raspberry puree with the darkest maple syrup we could find, topped with some extra chocolate. It drinks way too easy for the ABV, so be careful. We tried that for you.

name: Stout Bourbon 2021
text: Ty nejlepší osmnáctiměsíční sudy z letošní barelové "sklizně" jsme použili pro letošní nejryzejší blend. Kombinace bourbonových sudů od palíren Woodford Reserve a Jim Beam vytvořila velmi komplexní, intenzivní, přesto jemnou chuť, která slouží jako deklarace našich schopností, našich preferencí a naší představy o tom, kam sahají možnosti staření v bourbonových sudech.The best 18 months old bourbon barrels of this year's barrel "harvest" we joined in our purest blend. We combined barrels from Woodford Reserve and Jim Beam distilleries creating a very complex, intense but still smooth flavour, that stands as a manifest to our barrel aging capabilities.

name: Black Label #5: Ice Blueberry Cake Sour Ale
text: Letos jsme pekli babiččin borůvkový koláč. Takový ten úžasný s drobenkou a připečenými růžky. Na ozdobu jsme přidali červený rybíz a celé to vymrazili, aby to mělo grády. Račte se zakousnout.

name: Choco Orange Jelly Wheat Wine 2024
text: Cílem tohoto blendu tří pšeničných piv bylo napodobit slavné v čokoládě zalité vánoční gumové bonbóny. Po 30 měsících staření v dřevěných sudech jsme tedy přidali, pomeranče, pomorančovou kůru, kakaové boby a osladili javorovým sirupem. Výsledek je velmi zábavný a překvapivě pitelný. Dizajn etikety nám propůjčila teplická multidisciplinární umělkyně Hannah Saleh.The aim of this blend of three wheat beers was to emulate the famous chocolate-covered Christmas gummies. So after 30 months of aging in wooden barrels, we added, oranges, orange peel, cocoa beans and sweetened with maple syrup. The result is very fun and surprisingly drinkable. The label design was lent to us by the Teplice-based multidisciplinary artist Hannah Saleh.

name: Stout Bourbon – Barrel Project
text: Stupňovitost 34 / alk. 14,5 %Jedná se o imperiální stout, který ležel ve vybraných sudech po bourbonu po 18 měsíců. Chuťový prodil je velmi komplexní s tóny hořké čokolády, kávy a vanilky.

name: Winter Affair Gossip: Brew Your Mind
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Asi neexistuje moc lepších pocitů pro pivovarníka, jako když si může zavařit várku z některým ze svých největších vzorů. To je pro nás maďarský pivovar Brew Your Mind, jehož nekompromisně nádherně zpracované New England IPA v našich očích stojí na úplném vrcholu evropského pivovarnictví; a nahlédnout do hlavy sládkům za těmito legendárními pivy je prostě zážitek, který lze těžko replikovat.There's probably not much better feeling for a brewer than being able to brew a batch with some of their greatest inspirations. For us, that's Hungarian brewery Brew Your Mind, whose uncompromisingly beautifully crafted New England IPAs stand at the very top of European brewing in our eyes; and getting a glimpse into the minds of the brewers behind these legendary beers is simply an experience that's hard to replicate.

name: Vanilla Coffee Stout 2023
text: Pečlivě vyvážená kombinace kávy a vanilky obohatila tento blend dva roky stařených imperiálních stoutů a přináší vám tak velmi jemný, ale zároveň intenzivní zážitek, který vám možná bude připomínat irskou kávu. Umění na této etiketě pro nás vytvořil David Strauzz.A carefully balanced combination of coffee and vanilla has enriched this blend of two-year-old imperial stouts, bringing you a very delicate yet intense experience that may remind you of Irish coffee. The art on this label was created for us by David Strauzz.

name: Mexican Hot Chocolate Stout 2023
text: Tento blend dva roky stařených stoutů je letos asi ten nejvíce experimentální. Inspirovali jsme se u amerických producentů silných stoutů a vytvořili kombinaci, která v sobě pojí chuť skořice, pálivost chilli papriček a hořkost kakaových bobů. Umění na této etiketě vytvořil Martin Czeller.This blend of two-year-old stouts is probably our most experimental this year. We were inspired by American producers of strong stouts and created a combination that connects the taste of cinnamon, the heat of chili peppers and the bitterness of cocoa beans. The art on this label was created by Martin Czeller.

name: Coconut Stout 2021
text: Pro kokosovou verzi naší barelové série využíváme takové sudy, které si vyvinuly trošku drsnější profil než ostatní. Výraznější dřevité a hořké tóny jsou tak vyhlazeny jemností kokosové chuti. Tento blend 18 měsíců stařených stoutů přinese na stůl velmi vyvážený zážitek s intenzivní chutí bourbonových barelů a kokosu.In our coconut version of our barrel series we utilize such barrels that aged to be a bit rougher in character than the rest. The more pronounced woody and bitter tones are smoothened out with the soft mouthfeel of the coconut. This 18 months barrel-aged stout will therefore bring you an extremely well-balanced experienced with intense taste of bourbon barrels and coconut.

name: Two-Headed Giant
text: Triple NEIPA, 23° Plato, 9.5% ABV. Když dorazí na návštěvu kluci z Nepomucenu, je jasné, že to neskončí lehkým pivem. Nikdy předtím jsme neuvařili trojitou NEIPU a tahle spolupráce se nabídla jako dokonalá záminka to udělat. Množství pšenice a ovsa, dokonce trochu rýže, vytváří mohutnou, matně jemnou texturu a hustý zákal, zatímco nálož Sabra, Simcoe a Amarilla vás uvrhne přímo do středu ovocné exploze. Two-Headed Giant je vskutku mezinárodním útokem na vaše smysly.When guys from Nepomucen are coming for a visit, you know it won’t end up with subtle beer. We had never brewed a triple NEIPA before and this collab. provided a perfect excuse. Loads of wheat and oats, even some rice, create a big, velvety-smooth mouthfeel and thick haze, while onslaught of Sabro, Simcoe and Amarillo will dip you straight into the middle of a fruit salad. Still being quite dry and bitter, this Two-Headed Giant is a truly international attack on your senses.

name: duo des fleurs
text: A blend of spontaneously fermented beers with Pálava grapes and peaches aged in oak barrels for 18 months. Pálava is aromatic, local grape varietal with a lot of similarities to Gewürztraminer and great acidity on top. There are a plethora of things that inspire me with a vision for the conception of various beers. This particular beer is inspired by the sheer and touching beauty of the namesake opera duet and the environment around us. Have a listen! The interplay of those two delicate and fragrant fruits of the season, local ingredients and fermentation with graceful touch of time helped to create this unique beer. Close your eyes, slow down, calm down and let me know if you get what I meant. Music is such a gift to humanity!

name: Tonka Stout 2023
text: Fazole Tonka jsou surovinou jihoamerické a francouzské kuchyně, ve zbytku Evropy ji známe hlavně skrze pivovarnictví. Jde o tvrdé boby, které předávají kořenitou chuť podobnou skořici, hřebíčku, oříškům a vanilce a z našeho dva roky stařeného stoutu tak dělají opravdu příjemný dezertní zážitek. Etiketu má na svědomí Martin Kiman.Tonka beans are an ingredient of South American and French cuisine, in the rest of Europe we know them mainly through brewing. These are almond-like beans that impart a spicy flavor similar to cinnamon, cloves, nuts and vanilla, making our two-year-old stout a truly pleasant dessert experience. Martin Kiman is responsible for the label.

name: Eternal Winter
text: Barrel Aged English Barleywine, 30° Plato, 10.1% ABV. Zimu, náš barley wine, každou zimu vaříme s jiným receptem a tu před dvěma lety jsme prokvasili o něco méně, abychom ji připravili na dlouhé zrání ve dřevě. Díky jednoduchému sypání a pomalému, opatrnému kvašení s výraznými anglickými kvasnicemi, byla dost komplexní už předtím, než jsme ji uložili do starých, velkých sudů po Sherry, ve kterých mezitím zrála jedna z našich oblíbených jednosladových skotských whisky. Taky do čerstvého barelu po bourbonu. Nechali jsme je pak působit dlouhých 14 měsíců. Intenzivní tóny Sherry se krásně mísí s ovocnými estery, whisky dodává příjemně hřejivý nádech, bourbon zase vanilkovou sladkost a taniny ze dřeva vyvažují jemné jantarové tělo. Tohle pivo je určeno na dlouhé vychutnávaní z hezké sklenice. Pokud ho správně uložíte, vydrží dlouhá léta, ale vůbec to není potřeba – u nás si poleželo už dost.

name: Yummy Blackcurrant, Prunes & Tonka
text: Pastry Sour Ale w/ Blackcurrant, Prunes & Tonka, 23° Plato, 6.1% ABV. Náš nový tekutý dezert právě přichází! Kromě toho, že je toto Yummy tradičně hustě krémové, je také nádherně fialové a plné černého rybízu. Skvěle se snoubí s lehkou kouřovostí sušených švestek a bohatým aroma bobů tonka. Balancujíc mezi ovocnou sladkostí a kyselostí z mléčného kvašení, je to další pivo, která se vzpírá pivní tradici.Here comes the new liquid dessert! Besides being thick and creamy, this Yummy is gorgeously purple and crammed with blackcurrant. These pair nicely with the slight smokiness of prunes and the rich aroma of tonka beans. Balancing between fruity sweetness and sourness from lactic fermentation, this is yet another beer tradition-defying beast of a beer.

name: Here And Now: Cherry
text: Coolshipped and spontaneously fermented beer in an oak barrel for 16 months and aged further on organic local sour cherries for 12 months. In this one I am trying to capture the unique essence of one day into a beer and imprint of local terroir and layering the hand picked organic sour cherries from a local orchard. Multiple varieties of organic cherries give a really complex expression of the fruit and prolonged aging make for a deep, rich flavour. The backbone of a beer is built on local organic barley malt and raw organic spelt from the local Hare Krishna community, where they live and function in a low intervention and organic way for the last 3 decades.

name: Brewstock Juice 15
text: Kooperační várka s pivovarem Zhůřák.

name: Three Suns
text: Triple NEIPA, 24° Plato, 9.5% ABV. Tentokrát jsme to pojali ve velkém. Vysoký obsah alkoholu, vysoký podíl vloček a, což je nejdůležitější, obrovské množství chmele. Tohle je nejsilnější NEIPA, jakou jsme doposud uvařili, a chtěli jsme, aby tak i chutnala. Sáhli jsme proto po kombinaci chmelů Cryo Pop, Pacific Sunrise, Motueka a Talus pro dosažení pořádného chmelového charakteru plného papáji, marakuji, liči a žlutého melounu. Tohle krémové a expresivní pivo má za cíl zaútočit na vaše smysly svou intenzitou a hezky vás zahřát.This time we went big. Big on alcohol, big on oats and, most importantly, big on hops. This is the strongest NEIPA we’ve ever brewed and we wanted it to taste that way, so we went with combination of Cryo Pop, Pacific Sunrise, Motueka and Talus for a really intense hop character dominated by papaya, lychee, passion fruit and honeydew melon pulp. This smooth and expressive beer is designed to warm you up and overwhelm all your senses with its intensity.

name: Pentagram
text: Barrel Aged Imperial Stout, 27° Plato, 10.5% ABV. Pět dřevěných barelů (bourbon, sherry, whisky) tvoří tento komplexní, robustně pražený a hořký, ale zároveň jemný a harmonický stout. Pivo zrálo dlouhých 15 měsíců a charakteru dominuje aroma dýmu s nádechem slaného mořského vzduchu z whisky barelu, které vyvažují jemné vanilkové tóny bourbonu a náznak ovocného sherry. Nepospíchejte s ním – pijte ho pomalu a objevujte jeho jednotlivé vrstvy.The name is inspired by a selection of five barrels that went into this blend of wood-aged imperial stouts, where each of them plays its role. A combination of freshly emptied bourbon barrels, a whisky-filled Sherry cask and one intensely peated Islay whisky barrel that held several stouts for 15 months created a complex, oily beer. Roasty and bitter, yet smooth and harmonic, just the way we like them. The salty smokiness of the peat is balanced with light vanilla notes of bourbon and a touch of Sherry fruitiness,  creating the taste most closely resembling liquorice. That leads to a robust, intense finish with a slight warming sensation. Take your time and sip slowly to explore all of its layers.

name: Yummy Mango w/ Pineapple & Passion Fruit
text: Pastry Sour Ale w/ Mango, Pineapple & Passion Fruit,  20° Plato, 7.1% ABV. Barevné spojení piva a ovocného džusu: nerozumně šílené množství manga, ananasu a marakuji je smíchané s kyselým základem, vše je zjemněné vločkami a laktózou, což nám vytváří jasně žluté smoothie pro dospělé. A colourful clash of beer and fruit juice: unreasonable amounts of mango, pineapple and passion fruit mixed with sour base smoothened by oat/wheat flakes and lactose result in brightly yellow adult smoothie. We designed our juicy tropical beer to be less cloying and more drinkable, so you can enjoy this tropical paradise in bigger gulps.

name: Masala Chai Barley Wine 2024
text: 30 měsíců nám trvalo, než jsme usoudili, že jsou naše bourbonové sudy plné barley wine připravené na vyprázdnění. Toto je blend tří sudů, které jsme ochutili javorovým sirupem a směsí indického koření Masala Chai. Etiketu pro nás vytvořila nadaná výtvarnice a naše lounská sousedka Lenka Kladivová.It took us 30 months to finally decide that our bourbon barrels full of barley wine were ready to be emptied. This is a blend of three barrels that we flavored with maple syrup and a blend of Indian Masala Chai spices. The label was created for us by Lenka Kladivová, a talented artist and our neighbor from Louny.

name: Many Worlds Coming of Age (2019)
text: Many cultures golden beer aged in oak barrels with apricots.~The summer of 2019 was peculiar. As a heatwave advanced through the region of Moravia, these organic hand-picked apricots ripened astonishingly quickly, producing a lot of sweetness, yet keeping most of their sourness. This beer is a bottled timestamp of that unusual summer.

name: I Love It When You Talk Dirty To Me
Yummy Raspberry, Blackberry & Vanilla
text: Pastry Sour Ale w/ Raspberry, Blackberry & Vanilla, 20° Plato, 6.1% ABV. Naše poslední Yummy zmizelo dřív, než jsme čekali, proto jsme se promptně pustili do vaření dalšího. Ječný a pšeničný slad, pšeničné vločky a laktóza s obligátní hromadou vanilky opět vytvořili základ pro nápoj, který jen sotva připomíná pivo. Hlavním důvodem by mohlo být to, že maliny a ostružiny tvoří téměř polovinu jeho objemu. Tohle dekadentně husté, příjemně sladké a krémově husté pivo s osvěžujícím kyselým dojezdem je přesně to, co dnes lidi od tekutých dezertů pro dospělé pod jménem Yummy očekávají.Our last Yummy was gone sooner than we expected, so we promptly got to brewing another one. Malted barley and wheat, flaked wheat and lactose with an overdose of vanilla yet again create the base for what doesn’t really feel like a beer. That is mostly due to the fact that raspberries and blackberries make up almost half of the volume. Decadently thick, pleasantly sweet and smoothly thick with a refreshing tart finish, this is exactly what people came to expect from the liquid dessert for adults called Yummy.

name: Hungover Sniper
text: New England IPA, 17° Plato, 6.6% ABV. Moderní, hustá, krémová, robustní, světlá, zakalená a chmelem saturovaná NEIPA s obrovským množstvím chmelů Idaho 7, Citra, Motueka a Nectaronu v kombinaci s českými Saturn a Juno. Aroma zralých peckovin, manga, čerstvého pomerančového džusu s nádechem konopí.Modern, thick, creamy, robust, pale, murky NEIPA saturated with Idaho 7, Citra, Motueka, Nectaron, Saturn and Juno hops gives you layers upon layers of ripe stone fruit, mango and fresh orange juice with a touch of dankness.

name: Yummy Mango with Apricot
text: Pastry Sour Ale, 22° Plato, 6.7% ABV. Mohlo by být pivo ještě ovocnější, než naše dvě předchozí Yummy? Navýšili jsme množství ovoce a ovesných vloček a navíc přidali slušnou dávku mexické vanilky. Teď opravdu obsahuje více šťávy než piva. Zážitek začíná explozí manga, následuje příjemná vlna meruněk a končí osvěžujícím charakterem ovocného koláče. Jakmile se jednou napijete, je těžké přestat - takže buďte opatrní, protože po tomto zdravém začátku dne nebudete moct jít do práce.Could it get more fruity than our previous Yummy? Sure it does. This time we bumped up the amount of fruit, flaked oats and added a decent dose of Mexican vanilla. Now really more juice than beer, it starts with explosion of mango chased by a pleasant wave of apricots with refreshingly tart finish. After you have a sip it is difficult to stop, so be careful because you won’t go to work after this healthy start of the day.

name: ROLA-BOLA
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: ROLA-BOLA is a guy from a Circus. And not any circus. He's the third one from The Hoppy Circus Carnival which came to our city. Collab with our brother Maskeron is bringing this Double NE IPA with full & silky body and a lots of tropicals in aroma and flavour. Balancing with pineapple, vanilla and coconut notes, this beer is a real circus!

name: 5th Anniversary Beer #5 - Triple NEIPA
text: 5 BEERS FOR 5 YEARS! #5 in our 5th Anniversary Beer edition - all in at the end. One of the most popular NEIPA styles. Yes it's maybe hot for 9% and bunch of hops, but it's our birthday!

name: Fantastic Four
text: Birthday celebration special for our friends from Beer Sheep. We don't brew smoothies & pastries and we will never do ordinarly, but for friends you need to create whatever they like. Long Live Beer Sheep, the best beer shop in Belgrade!

name: Brain Blocker
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Brain Blocker je potreba da ovo vreme ucinimo laksim. Pitkoca standardne NeIpe uz ne tako naivnih 8% alk. Double NeIpa duplo hmeljena Idaho, Eldorado, Citra i Mozaic hmeljevima.

name: The Worst Beer Geek Ever
text: He's Rangel. He's our Bulgarian brother and the main and only guy behind Dogma Brewery Bulgaria project. Recently he became a gypsy brewer thru his new project Bad Manners Gypsy Brewing Co. And all of that is cool. But he is still THE WORST BEER GEEK EVER. We brewed this super juicy IPA which was triple dry hopped. We've bringing you orange. Squeeze it & enjoy!

name: Serbian Barrels Series No. 1 - Imperial Stout
text: No. 1 in our, worldwide unique barrel aging series - SERBIAN BARRELS SERIES! We're using only Serbian barrels & here we have an Imperial Stout with cardamom & cocoa nibs, aged over a year in 26 (now 27!) old Serbian Vinjak (Cognac) barrels. Prepare the senses & enjoy!

name: 02 Kolaboracija Caramel Stout
text: Caramel stout aged for 6 months in oak barrels of the famous Arkanj brandy (Calvados) made by the Kovilj Monastery. For three years in Top 50 stouts of the world. Best beer in Serbia by Ratebeer.

name: Bon Baisers De Belgrade
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: We met our Zythologist friends in Bruge. After that they came to Belgrade and here we are - sending all the love and kisses from Belgrade! Thru this super juice DIPA boosted with Citra & Talus... Enjoy our friend!

name: Juice It Up!
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Juice it up! Just juice it up! Give me more. Just give me more! This DDH DIPA got a flavour from CItra Incognito and aroma of El Dorado, Citra and Mosaic. It's juicy & and it bringht you more. Of everything!

name: Peacock #5
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Double NE IPA, sa Sabro cryo, Citra cryo i Mosaic hmeljevima u dry hopu.Ziveli!

name: Westie of the Tulips
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Westie Of The Tulips came a long way from Netherlands for our first collaboration with Dutch breweries. This beer is potent & juicy. That's just enough to tell!

name: Rigor Mortis
text: Rigor Mortis, zver koja je je svoju apsolutnu ličnost oformila u periodu od 12 meseci u Merlot/Probus buradima. Struktura dominantnog karaktera dovela je do sveobuhvatne koegzistencije složenog pivskog ukusa i egzotičnog vinskog karaktera.

name: Three Hoppy Sisters
text: Strast prema kuvanju piva ne krijemo, a traganje za novim ukusima nas je često odvelo ne samo do novog pivskog recepta već i do sjajnih saradnji sa drugim pivarama. Tako se ideja o Three hoppy sisters pivu rodila. Simbolično, Three hoppy sisters predstavlja sponu između @twohoppysisters i Zbir pivare. Smela i do sad zapravo neviđena kod nas, ova Triple Neipa satkana je od obilja ječma, pšenice i hmelja. Kremasta, balansirane gorčine sa mrvicom kiselkastih nota, Three hoppy sisters biće vam definitivno dobro društvo nakon napornog dana i dnevnih obaveza.

name: Serbian Barrels Series #7 - Imperial Quince Sour
text: Number 7 is here! An Imperial Quince Sour produced with mixed fermentation - imperial kettle sour on one & fermented quince wine on other. Those two mixed went to Serbian wine barrels and aged for six months.

name: Black Widow Kentucky Bourbon
text: Russian Imperial Stout aged 9 months in Kentucky Bourbon barrels.

name: Muma Paduri Mountain IPA
text: Muma Paduri is a myth. She's Mother of Nature which protects woods in Eastern Serbia. And it's perfect to descirbe our collaboration brew with friends from Zmajska Pivovara - this new hybrid among IPA's. Super potent, somewhere between West & East Coast, but still American IPA in all atributes!

name: 5th Anniversary Beer #4 - KVEIK NEIPA
text: 5 BEERS FOR 5 YEARS! #4 in our 5th Anniversary Beer edition - that nasty  KVEIK yeast is to blame for this juicy brew. There is also our friend Minja with his Dead Water Brewing Co. homebrew alias and his knowledge for this beer style. Cheers brother!

name: HOPE
text: Dictionary says that HOPE is a feeling of expectation and desire for a particular thing to happen. As the whole planet went to a lockdown, we decided to brew this juicy hazy IPA with loads of Sabro, El Dorado, Idaho 7 and Citra hops. And we decided with our partners from Ball Packaging to donate 100 dinars from every can and to help socially vulnerable groups in our country!

name: MANGOA
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Story about GOA island is well known all over the world. Story about MANGOA will be written by every sip of yours. Full & rich, well balanced and powerfull, this true milkshake in a beer world will make your day colorfull! Yes you'll start to fantasize about the island of GOA. Party can start with mango & milky tones fully supported by a touch of Sabro hops!

name: Peacock #4
text: Grejp, mango, breskva - ova paleta ukusa, našeg IV nastavka Paun serijala, nikad nije bila izraženija - novim hmeljevima Simcoe cryo i Citra cryo, citrusni ukusi su podignuti na najviši nivo.

name: Crasher
text: Dupli Dry Hop(DDH) uz 4 vrste američkih hmeljeva i dodatak pšenice,spelta,ovsa i ječma u kombinaciji sa tečnim verdant kvascem donose aromatičnu mutnu i nefiltriranu NEIPU pravo na vaša nepca.

name: Shake Those Melons
text: DDH Milkshake IPA with melon, a tropical bomb in your mouth.

name: High Grade
text: Friendship = Craft Brewing. Yes it is! This beer is a product of first ever brewing at the same time. Night in Belgrade &  morning in Sydney. Same recipe brewed in the same moment. Slovenian, New Zealand & Australian hops. I will just say that this beer is AMAZING! :D

name: 8th AB - Lost In A Hop Field
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: One of two brewery collabs for our 8th Anniversary. We've lost in a hop field with our brew brothers from Crow Brewery.

name: HOP SHOWER
text: Everybody likes good shower. Brewers like it like a hop shower! Super potent NEIPA with El Dorado, Simcoe, Citra & Columbus gives you orange punch on every sip.
1019 is a hop we fell in love with last year at CBC. It's just unique and cause of that we've bring it first to Serbian craft beer fans!

name: Vinje Draku Pista Garda
text: Draku is a word for devil in Romanian. This sentence is unique one and Romanians dont have it as its specific for Vlachian minority in Eastern Serbia. It means "Devil comes over the fence". This beer is not so evil - its just a Kveik NEIPA brewed with our Romanian brothers from Bereta. Kveik Voss meets Citra, Bru-1 & a bit of Sabro!

name: Ludilo
text: Milkshake IPA.Collaboration with Bottle Share (RU).

name: SARCASM
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Brewers are pretty sarcastic when they're saying that they like to brew NEIPA! Becayse they're "enjoying" in all operations from malt milling thru lautering to heavy double dry hopping :D Because of this we called this juicy collaboration brew SARCASM! Enjoy while you drinking. Not like brewers! :D

name: Vista Mikkeller IPA#2
text: Vista series dramatically continues, as the label story unfolds so does the new IPA style! Number two represents a powerful blend of fruit flavors,  beside its higher alcohol content. From today, let’s spice up the days, with this spectacular beer that will raise the pulse and atmosphere.

name: Coast To Coast
text: Collab with our friends from Nice. We are bringing you this Citra & Nelson Sauvin NEIPA from coast of Belgrade river Sava to coast Blue coast of France!

name: All Together
text: We're super proud to be part of All Together beer which came from our colleagues from Other Half! This NE IPA brings you smoothness & hop power of Mosaic, Citra, Comet and Enigma. We're in this ALL TOGETHER! #AllTogetherBeer

name: Alpha Dog
text: Alpha Dog -  A razor-sharp leader of the pack of wild dogs: Centennial, Citra, Galaxy, Mosaic, Sabro, Chinook, Columbus.Made out of six hops and a double dry hop for the impeccable strength, that only the brave can relate to. This Triple IPA is an adventure in a glass, that slides down like heavenly nectar and bangs like the hammer of God. No leash can hold it, and its tail wags for no one.

name: Pudding IPA
text: New England IPA sa dodatkom pudinga od vanile i mlečnog šećera.

name: Citrozaik
text: Prava žurka od piva se zakuvala u 3biru. Citrozaik je plod tropskih vibracija i letnje žege. Citra i Mozaik su dežurni krivci za fantastične arome, a blend 3 kvasca podiže igru na novi nivo. Recept iz budućnosti za pivo koje pravimo danas!

name: Serbian Barrels Series No.5 - Imperial Coffee Stout
text: Number 5 in our unique BA series where we're using ONLY Serbian barrels. This time, in 27 years old Serbian Vinjak (Cognac) barrel we've put Imperial Coffee Stout. One 500L barrel & that's it ladies & gents!

name: Shake
text: Mlečna senzacija prefinjenih aroma koja će ti promućkati glavu! Stout, lagan i pitak, punog ukusa i bogate arome najfinije mlečne čokolade, karamele, jutarnjeg kapućina, sa slatkom jagodom u završnici. Prava poslastica!

name: Hazy Alpaca
text: Our new NEIPA is double dry hoped widh Idaho 7, Eldorado, Citra and Mosaic hops in a combination with verdant yeast.

name: Black Fire
text: Skladno spremljena tinktura čokolade, kafe, suvih šljiva, porto vina sa čak 8 vrsta specijalnih sladova. Lekoviti balzam koji miluje dušu. Počastite se ovom poslasticom i spasite svet od kataklizme!

name: Black Widow
text: Black Widow is Russian Imperial Stout brewed with mix of pils, caramel malts, chocolate malt, and roast barley.

name: Lollihop

name: XYAUYU' KENTUCKY - RISERVA 2015
text: ITALIANO - Alla Xyauyù viene abbinato un prodotto dell’eccellenza agricola italiana: il tabacco Kentucky, aggiunto con infusione a freddo in barrique di rovere. Il risultato è una birra dai profumi e dai sapori decisi, ma allo stesso tempo delicati. Color oro rosso carico, priva di schiuma e gasatura, al naso offre sentori di frutta secca, ciliegia sotto spirito e tabacco macerato. In bocca gli aromi di vaniglia contrastano con la sensazione piccante, quasi di cuoio, tipica del Kentucky. ENGLISH - Teo ventures again into the world of macro-oxidation. This new exploration of taste starts from Xyauyù Oro, combined with a product of the best Italian farming: Kentucky tobacco. Using a cold infusion technique, tobacco is added to the oak barrels where the beer is kept. A unique beer is obtained, with strong and at the same time delicate scents and tastes, reminiscent of the atmosphere of past days. It has a clear, dark golden red color with brownish hues. When poured, it has no head and no gas. Scents of dried fruit and cherries in alcohol, while the sweet aroma of macerated tobacco stands out. The taste is a perfect balance between the malty flavors and the taste of tobacco. Hints of vanilla contrast the typical tangy, almost leathery notes of tobacco. A blend of tastes which gives this beer a bitter, dry finish.

brewery: BIRRIFICIO AGRICOLO BALADIN - Baladin Indipendent Italian Farm Brewery
name: XYAUYÙ KENTUCKY -RISERVA 2016
text: ITA - Un Barley Wine dal colore rosso scuro, limpido e senza schiuma. All’olfatto, note immediate di tabacco e caramello con un finale leggero di vaniglia. In bocca, la componente legnosa fa da sostegno ai toni di tabacco ben equilibrati con le note di frutta secca e cioccolato fondente.ENG -A barley wine with a dark red, bright color and no head. The scents of tobacco and caramel immediately emerge, with a final light touch of vanilla. When sipped, the wood component stands out and supports the notes of tobacco, which strike a good balance with the hints of nuts and dark chocolate.

brewery: BIRRIFICIO AGRICOLO BALADIN - Baladin Indipendent Italian Farm Brewery
name: XYAUYÙ BARREL - RISERVA 2014
text: ITALIANOUna birra ad alta fermentazione che ha subito un processo di macro ossidazione e dodici mesi di maturazione in botti da rhum, che le donano un aroma ed un gusto del tutto caratteristici. Si presenta al bicchiere priva di schiuma e gasatura.ENGLISHIt represents the complex expression of Teo’s mind in the creation of his couch beers. An high fermented beer after a macro oxidation process and 12 month aging in rhum barrels, which give a natural and turbid aroma. In the glass is without cream and gas.

brewery: BIRRIFICIO AGRICOLO BALADIN - Baladin Indipendent Italian Farm Brewery
name: XYAUYÙ etichetta oro/golden label - RISERVA 2014
text: ITALIANO - Una birra viva ad alta fermentazione che incontrando l’aria pura delle Langhe e riposando per lungo tempo è divenuta un prodotto nuovo, unico. All’aspetto si presenta limpida, priva di schiuma e gasatura, con un colore intenso, di tono ambrato carico e riflessi ramati. Al primo naso esprime grande intensità, emergono sentori di frutta secca e canditi con importanti e armoniose note che ci riportano al vino Madeira. XYAUYÙ, è ottima con il cioccolato e bevuta con calma a fine pasto. ENGLISH - Xyauyù is a living, top-fermented beer which – after being exposed to the air of the Langhe area and resting for a long period of time – becomes a new and unique product. When poured, it has no head and no gas; it has a clear, full amber, brownish color with copper reflections. When initially inhaled it is very intense, with aromas of dried and candied fruit and strong and harmonious notes which bring Madeira wines to mind. XYAUYÙ, is excellent with chocolate and drink slowly after a meal.

text: ITALIANO - Alla Xyauyù viene abbinato un prodotto dell’eccellenza agricola italiana: il tabacco Kentucky, aggiunto con infusione a freddo in barrique di rovere. Il risultato è una birra dai profumi e dai sapori decisi, ma allo stesso tempo delicati. Color oro rosso carico, priva di schiuma e gasatura, al naso offre sentori di frutta secca, ciliegia sotto spirito e tabacco macerato. In bocca gli aromi di vaniglia contrastano con la sensazione piccante, quasi di cuoio, tipica del Kentucky. ENGLISH - Teo ventures again into the world of macro-oxidation. This new exploration of taste starts from Xyauyù Oro, combined with a product of the best Italian farming: Kentucky tobacco. Using a cold infusion technique, tobacco is added to the oak barrels where the beer is kept. A unique beer is obtained, with strong and at the same time delicate scents and tastes, reminiscent of the atmosphere of past days. It has a clear, dark golden red color with brownish hues. When poured, it has no head and no gas. Scents of dried fruit and cherries in alcohol, while the sweet aroma of macerated tobacco stands out. The taste is a perfect balance between the malty flavors and the taste of tobacco. Hints of vanilla contrast the typical tangy, almost leathery notes of tobacco. A blend of tastes which gives this beer a bitter, dry finish.

name: XYAUYÙ KIOKE
text: ITA-Xyauyù Kioke è una birra che unisce due grandi tradizioni artigiane legate al mondo della fermentazione: l’arte di produrre birra artigianale, incontra l’arte di produrre salsa di soia artigianale. Kioke è una botte priva di chiusura, in legno di Cipresso, prodotta in Giappone, nell’isola di Shodo da Yasuo Yamamoto (Yamaroku Shoyu) in cui fermenta la soia. Xyauyù nasce in Italia, a Piozzo, nel birrificio agricolo Baladin, dal desiderio di Teo Musso di esplorare l’universo delle ossidazioni.La birra, già fermentata e maturata per oltre 18 mesi, viene affinata “a cielo aperto” in una botte di Kioke nuova in cui non è stata fermentata la soia e che le dona note resinose di Cipresso e una leggera sfumatura acida, creando un profilo aromatico unico e originale.ENG-Xyauyù Kioke combines two great craft traditions in the world of fermentation: the art of beer making meets the art of producing craft soy sauce. The Kioke is an open cypress wooden barrel produced by Yasuo Yamamoto (Yamaroku Shoyu) in Japan, on the island of Shodo, and is used for the fermentation of soy sauce. Xyauyù was created in Piozzo, Italy, at the Baladin farm brewery, from Teo Musso’s desire to explore the universe of oxidation.The beer, once fermented and aged for 18 months, is open-air matured inside a new Kioke barrel, i.e. which has never been used for the fermentation of soy. The barrel gives resinous cypress notes and a slightly acidic touch, for a unique aromatic profile.

name: Mansueto 2023
text: Invecchiata prevalentemente in botti di Rum, Whisky e Porto, con un tocco di botte di vino, fa vivere un'esperienza straordinaria. Il colore ambrato profondo e gli aromi caramellati si fondono con note fruttate di uva passa e datteri. Il gusto rivela strati complessi di caramello, toffee e vaniglia, arricchiti da accenni di rovere e una piacevole leggera piccantezza persistente che aggiunge energia. Una birra che incanta con la sua armonia.  Dedicata a una persona speciale scomparsa qualche anno fa: il nostro caro falegname Mansueto. Abbiamo realizzato assieme a lui i supporti per le botti che ora sono impiegati nella nostra Cantina. Mansueto ha condiviso con noi la sua passione per il legno e per le cose fatte con le mani.Aged predominantly in barrels of Rum, Whisky, and Port, with a touch of wine barrel, it provides an extraordinary experience. The deep amber color and caramelized aromas blend with fruity notes of raisins and dates. The taste reveals complex layers of caramel, toffee, and vanilla, enriched with hints of oak and a pleasant light persistent spiciness that adds energy. A beer that enchants with its harmony.Dedicated to a special person who passed away a few years ago: our dear carpenter Mansueto. Together with him, we made the supports for the barrels that are now used in our cellar. Mansueto shared with us his passion for wood and things made by hand.

text: Anche il 2022 ci ha “regalato” una grande annata per la nostra Mansueto.Dopo i periodici assaggi durante l’anno che ci davano ottime speranze per un’annata importante, nelle ultime settimana le degustazioni dalle diverse botti, di Rum, Vino, Bourbon e Whisky, si sono fatte più serrate per poter ricreare quel momento, per noi magico, della creazione della nuova annata di Mansueto 2022 che non vediamo l’ora arrivi nelle vostre mani per poterla finalmente assaggiare.Fra le diverse botti assaggiare due avevano un carattere unico e complesso tanto da meritarsi l’etichetta “Riserva 2022”.The year 2022 also 'gave' us a great vintage for our Mansueto.After periodic tastings during the year that gave us high hopes for an important vintage, in the last few weeks the tastings from the different barrels, of Rum, Wine, Bourbon and Whisky, have become more intense in order to recreate that moment, magical for us, of the creation of the new Mansueto 2022 vintage that we cannot wait for to arrive in your hands so that you can finally taste it.Among the different barrels we tasted, two had such a unique and complex character that they deserved the label 'Riserva 2022'.

name: Notte Di Natale 2025 (Maple & Irish Whiskey Barrel Aged)
text: Il blend '25 è di 3 botti (due differenti ricette, con Plato compreso tra 31° e 34°).Una volta trasferito il blend in acciaio, è stato lasciato riposare per alcune settimane affinché ogni componente potesse armonizzarsi con le altre, definendo un profilo gustativo unico.Le fave di cacao provenienti dal Ghana sono tostate e trasformate in granella. La base densa già esaltava tutta la varietà di cioccolato / gianduia ed è stato scelto di procedere alla tostatura prestando attenzione a non esagerare con le temperature. Abbiamo utilizzato anche una parte di fave non tostate. La cannella “Cassia” è stata impiegata sia in stecche sminuzzate sia in polvere. Ne abbiamo usata in quantitativi elevati e tempi di contatto brevi. Ci piace spostare l’impatto aromatico della cannella nel finale della bevuta per accompagnare il ricco e dolce profilo di cacao.Lo sciroppo d’acero è l’insostituibile extra-dark che contribuisce alla dolcezza, conferisce morbidezza e profondità alla “Notte di Natale” e aggiunge ulteriori livelli di complessità

name: Mansueto 2021
text: Il momento in cui nasce il nostro Barley Wine è un momento magico. name: Inno All'Autunno
text: E’ la rappresentazione in forma liquida della nostra stagione preferita.Brassata a gennaio 2021 con il nostro malto Pils, malto cara50 italiano e un tocco di chocolate, la ricetta prevede aggiunta di zucchero muscovado in più momenti della produzione.Maturata per 17 mesi in botti di American Rye e Irish Whiskey.La scelta è ricaduta su questa tipologia di botti per enfatizzare le speziature ed i particolari aromi di frutta matura del lievito Westmalle. La parte aromatica si distingue per il potente equilibrio tra tutte le componenti. Legno, distillato, charred, vaniglia proveniente dalle botti; cioccolato al latte, frutta secca, caramello caldo, tostature dolci provenienti dai malti;prugne sciroppate, esteri e fenoli contenuti, secchezza proveniente dal lievito.Questa Quadrupel si rivela profonda, introversa e piena di sfumature, come l’autunno appena cominciato.

text: La prima collaborazione con Pasticceria Giotto è stata il panettone con Magma Bianco.Poi abbiamo preso lo stesso panettone e abbiamo creato Giotto.Giotto è una Pastry Stout piatta, senza bollicine, maturata per 24 mesi in botti di Chardonnay con una grande quantità di Panettone.Densa, oleosa e ovviamente sa di panettone… Giotto.The first collaboration with Pasticceria Giotto was the panettone with Magma Bianco.Then we took the same panettone and created Giotto.Giotto is a flat Pastry Stout, without bubbles, matured for 24 months in Chardonnay barrels with a large amount of Panettone.Dense, oily and obviously tastes like panettone... Giotto.

text: ITALIANO - Rappresenta l’espressione più complessa della ricerca di Teo nella creazione delle sue birre da divano. Una birra ad alta fermentazione che ha subito un processo di macro ossidazione e dodici mesi di maturazione, in botti da whisky scozzese delle Islay, che le donano un naturale aroma torbato. Di colore bruno intenso con riflessi ramati, si presenta al bicchiere priva di schiuma e gasatura.ENGLISH - Xyauyù Fumè is the most complex expression of Teo’s approach to the creation of what he calls “couch beers”, to be enjoyed and savored slowly. It is a top-fermented beer which has undergone macro-oxidation and has been aged for twelve months in Islay Scottish whisky barrels, which give it a natural peaty flavor. It has a deep dark color with copper nuances; when poured, it has no head and no gas.
